description: Non-material amendments to conditions 2 (approved drawings/documents), 20 (hard & soft landscaping), 26 (external materials), 33 (secured by design), description of development and insertion of additional conditions relating to:CIL Phasing; The Hub -  Landscaping; The Hub - Public Realm works; Method Statement and Risk Assessment - Network Rail; Scaffolding Works - Network Rail; Demolition Methodology Statement - Network Rail; Drainage - Network Rail; Groundworks - Network Rail; Risk Assessment and Method Statement - Network Rail; Vehicle Safety Protection - Network Rail; and Trespassing - Network Rail of Full Planning Permission reference 24/3106 dated 20 July, 2026, for "Demolition of all buildings and structures; phased redevelopment of the two land parcels either side of Great Central Way to provide an industrial complex comprising five new buildings, split across five industrial units, for flexible Class E(g)(iii)/B2/B8 use, with ancillary office space, an affordable workspace building with flexible ground floor cafe use (Use Class E), parking and servicing areas, means of enclosure, cycle parking, landscaping and access for vehicles and pedestrians. Subject to a Legal Agreement made under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) dated the 26 June 2026
